additions.meaning: An exact current offline entitlement tuple and trusted time/authority/version evidence are required; missing or stale evidence denies protected work.

Fallback requires the exact authorized alternate implementation/profile and typed compatibility facts, repeats policy checks before the alternate effect boundary, and denies unknown compatibility without silent substitution.

reviewBasis: The later owner additions are exact, fail-closed definitions. The offline rule requires a valid entitlement/time window before protected work; the fallback compatibility rule requires an exact named alternate and typed compatibility facts plus fresh policy checks before crossing its effect boundary. Both preserve deny/unknown behavior and do not authorize acquisition, fallback execution, qualification, or runtime admission.
